brief:
President Donald Trump said Tuesday that he had reached an agreement with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu under which the United States would cease providing military aid to Israel after the end of 2026, according to Al-Monitor.

Trump did not elaborate on the terms of the purported deal or circumstances that prompted the decision to end aid that has been a cornerstone of U.S. support for Israel for decades.
dek: WASHINGTON, Nov 3 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump on Tuesday said he made a deal with Israeli Prime Minister BenjaminNetanyahu and that Washington would no longer be providingmilitary aid to Israel after the end of this year.
title: Trump says US will halt $4 billion Israel military aid in 2026
